LESSON: SUBTRACTION

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.5: Subtraction

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Subtraction. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-039.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 39]]

From your pupil's book (page 39)

NUMBERS SUBTRACTION Week 5 Lesson 4 Subtract

Activity What is 7 – 4? Count 4 steps backwards from 7 ; 6, 5, 4, 3 - 4 = 3

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-105.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 105]]

From your pupil's book (page 105)

NUMBERS SUBTRACTION Week 5 Lesson 2 Subtract

Activity What is 70 – 30? 70 is 7 tens and 30 is 3 tens

7 tens take away 3 tens is 4 tens. 4 tens is 40

2. 50 - 20 = 4. 90 - 50 = 5. A father had 40 cows. He gave his daughter 10 cows. How many cows was he left with? 6. Alice had 80 packets of milk. She gave her friends 30 packets. How many packets of milk was she left with?

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-107.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 107]]

From your pupil's book (page 107)

TERM 2 Week 5 Lesson 4 Add and Subtract Activity Use addition and subtraction + 8 = 15 With addition, we write and 8 + 7 = 15 + 8 = 15 With subtraction, we write - 8 = 7 and 15 - 7 = 8 The numbers 7, 8, 15 make a number family.

Work to do 1. 9 + 5 = 14 5 + 9 = 14 - = 9 14 - 9 =

4. 12 + 3 = 3 + 12 = 15 - 3 = 15 - 1 2 = 95

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Subtraction means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Subtraction.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Subtraction
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2
4. Revise with the quiz now.
